title: Air France checked-baggage guidance
summary: Air France says checked-baggage allowance depends on the destination and fare and is shown on the ticket. Partner-operated segments may have different conditions; for connections, follow the strictest applicable guidance. Confirm the final priced offer for ticket-specific terms.

children.text: This is general airline guidance, not an entitlement for a particular ticket. Use the checked-bag information shown in the final priced offer and ticket; assess every segment when an itinerary includes a partner carrier or connection.

title: Iberia fare-service guidance
summary: Iberia says services such as checked baggage, changes, and refunds vary by fare and flight. Open the fare details for the exact terms, then use the final priced offer as the ticket-specific source.

children.text: General fare guidance does not establish whether a particular offer includes a bag, allows changes, or permits a refund. Review the fare details for the selected flight and confirm the final offer before purchase.

title: Turkish Airlines fare-rules guidance
summary: Turkish Airlines says fare conditions vary by route, date, and booking class. Review the fare notes during purchase and use the final priced offer to assess the terms for a specific itinerary.

children.text: This article gives general context only. It does not establish change, refund, or baggage conditions for a ticket; review the applicable fare notes and final offer before purchasing.

definition: Baggage handed to the carrier for transport in the aircraft hold. Inclusion and limits can vary by fare, route, and traveler, so the priced offer is the ticket-specific source.
